errors.evidence: In the 'nicht verändert' category, the bar for 'Dienstleistungen ohne öffentlichen Dienst' (light blue) is visibly shorter than the bar for 'Produzierendes Gewerbe inklusive Bau' (dark blue, ~53%). Its value is approximately 52%, not 54%.

The description uses 'blaue Balken' (blue bars) for the dark blue series and 'hellblaue Balken' (light blue bars) for the light blue series. This is ambiguous; 'dunkelblaue Balken' (dark blue bars) would be more precise.
